messages:
alex_fernandez: quick q — rolling out SCIM deprovisioning in staging. before we flip it, two quick security/privacy checks

1) logs: authsvc currently logs the full SCIM payload (includes userName/email and externalId). is it ok to keep the email in ELK for debugging, or should we redact/mask before shipping? any recommended minimal fields to retain for triage without exposing PII?

2) group mapping & nesting: Okta has nested groups (dept -> team). SCIM push gives a flat list of group IDs on first sync. should we try to resolve nesting synchronously during provisioning, or accept best-effort assignment and run a background resolver? worried about race on first-time-provision when deeper team groups arrive later.

also need a temporary sandbox org-admin to validate deprovision flows and run a couple repros. pinging @sara_chen for approvals — ETA today if possible.

current logged snippet: 
```
POST /scim/v2/Users 200
{
  "id": "b7f9",
  "userName": "alex+redwood@example.com",
  "externalId": "okta|00u7xyz",
  "groups": ["okta:eng:platform", "okta:eng:infra"]
}
```

proposed redaction example:
```
{
  "id": "b7f9",
  "userName": "[REDACTED_EMAIL]",
  "externalId": "okta|00u7xyz",
  "groups": ["okta:eng:platform", "okta:eng:infra"]
}
```

thanks — trying to avoid a PII slip during rollout.

sara_chen: approved: temporary sandbox org-admin for alex_fernandez for 2 hours (staging-sso-2026). please only use for the repro and revoke when done. regarding logs: redact emails before they hit ELK. keep externalId and a hashed userName for triage (store the full userName in the authsvc local audit table with restricted access if you need full traceability). recommended fields to keep in ELK: externalId, id, groups, event_type, request_id, hashed_user (sha256 prefix 8). do NOT store raw emails in log indices. :lock:

morgan_sre: granted sandbox org-admin to alex_fernandez on staging-sso-2026 for 2h. action id: OPS-2026-77. will annotate the audit log and set a temporary policy tag. when finished, drop access and post the confirmation here. noted on ELK redaction, will coordinate a small deploy to authsvc to redact before ship.

jamie_ml: for nested groups i vote: do lightweight sync during provisioning (assign any direct groups you see) + enqueue a background resolver that fetches group hierarchy and materializes internal roles when the dependent groups arrive. make resolver idempotent and mark user record with provisioning_state = "pending_groups" until resolved. that avoids long blocking in the auth path and reduces head-of-line latency. also add a small reconciliation job that runs after full SCIM sync to catch missed/late-arriving groups.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: authsvc:scim-redaction-v1 -> staging at 2026-03-18T10:00:00Z (canary 10%, 5m), job id deploy-5582.

morgan_sre: +1 to jamie's approach. additional checklist:
- make group resolver tolerant of duplicate ids and unknown groups (log but don't fail provision)
- surface provisioning_state in the admin UI so support can see "pending_groups" users
- emit metrics: scim.provision.duration, scim.resolve.backfill.count, scim.redaction.errors

alex_fernandez: awesome, thanks all. i'll update the PR with redaction logic (hash prefix + remove email) and add the background resolver + state flag. i'll post when the sandbox run is done and confirm access revoked. :thumbsup:
